# motivates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:motivates`](gmeow-motivates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/motivates>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a desire, intention, or commitment to an event the agent undertook (at least in part) because of it — the teleological reading of action. NOT functional, and an attributed-motive claim like any other: whose reading of the motive it is rides [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9); the deception module's [`deceptiveIntentClaim`](gmeow-deceptiveIntentClaim.md) is the adversarial special case). Grounds cn:MotivatedByGoal and atomic:xIntent at alignment time.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:motivates`](gmeow-motivates.md) from [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Goal And Intention

- **Source:** [`slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention)#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: goals, intentions, and commitments. GMEOW separates the
# intentional moments gUFO keeps distinct: a gmeow:Goal is the SocialObject an
# agent aims at (gmeow:hasGoal); a gmeow:Intention is an intentional MODE borne by
# an agent that aims at that goal (gmeow:intentionGoal) and MOTIVATES concrete
# action (gmeow:motivates → an Event); a gmeow:Commitment is a relator binding a
# committed agent to a beneficiary. The desire-to / intend-to / commit-to layers
# are not collapsed — each is its own first-class moment.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/teleology/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- The intention: an intentional mode borne by Dana, aimed at the goal, that
#     motivates a concrete action (the graduation event).
ex:intention a gmeow:Intention ;
    gmeow:intentBearer  ex:dana ;
    gmeow:intentionGoal ex:degreeGoal ;
    gmeow:motivates     ex:graduation .
```

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the teleological reading of an action — the desire, intention, or commitment that (at least partly) explains why an agent undertook an event.

### Avoid when

- Avoid stating a motive as a global fact when it is attributed rather than avowed; carry the reading's owner on [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) (the deception module's [`deceptiveIntentClaim`](gmeow-deceptiveIntentClaim.md) is the adversarial case), and never make it functional — an event may have several motives.

### How to use

- Link the moment to one or more [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) individuals and, where the motive is anyone's reading rather than ground truth, attach [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement; leave plan search and means-end inference to the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
